verdict.rationale: Helix Cloud is a documented managed offering with its own gateway, limits, security and multi-tenancy docs, and a community post confirms it as a paid hosted plan. Provisioning is scriptable through the official CLI: `helix auth login`, workspace/project/database/cluster listing with JSON output, and `helix database create --project --name --slug --plan`. The Cloud MCP endpoint also exposes customer administration tools. Missing for 10: a documented provisioning REST API or IaC/Terraform support beyond the CLI, programmatic API token creation (tokens are dashboard-managed), and independent hands-on corroboration of cloud provisioning.
